U3: Port SFTP module from Spring XD to s-c-s repo. (Module porting, testing)
U4: Create new project for `@RedisRule` contract. (Test utility extraction, refactoring)
U5: Create foundation to support processor as OOTB modules. (Module loading, classpath, SPI)
U6: Enable offline mode for `AetherModuleResolver`. (Maven Aether/Maven Resolver configuration, caching)
U7: Create `ModuleRegistry` implementation. (Registry interface and implementation, data store)
U8: Add `module info`, `module list`, `module register`, `module unregister` commands. (CLI commands, shell integration)

Total: 1.5 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 2.5 + 3 + 2 = 18 days.

- Use Spring Shell for the CLI commands.

- Implement `ModuleRegistry` using an in-memory map initially, backed by a persistent store if needed.

technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven for build management and dependency resolution to handle uber-jar conflicts and module extraction.
Use Spring Shell for implementing the module management CLI commands (info, list, register, unregister).
Use Maven Resolver (formerly Ather) for implementing the offline mode in AetherModuleResolver.
Implement ModuleRegistry using an in-memory data structure initially, with an interface designed for future persistent backing stores.
Design the OOTB processor module foundation using Spring's standard configuration and classpath scanning mechanisms.
assumptions: The developer is familiar with the Spring Cloud Data Flow (s-c-d) and Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) codebases.
Existing CI/CD pipelines are in place and will be updated to accommodate new projects and modules.
Unit and integration tests are required for all new features and refactoring.
The external library to be moved is clearly identified and has minimal coupling.
The SFTP module from Spring XD can be ported with standard Spring Integration components.

activities.activity_description: Configure Maven build to enforce external libraries from overriding any existing library in the uber-jar (U1).
Move the external library to its own project to separate functionalities in the s-c-d repo and update dependencies (U2).
Port the SFTP module from Spring XD to the s-c-s repo, including configuration and tests (U3).
Create a new project to contain all rules associated with the @RedisRule contract, isolating it from core functionalities and updating references (U4).
Create the foundation to support processor as OOTB modules in the s-c-d repo (U5).
Enable offline mode for AetherModuleResolver to pull module artifacts from local Maven repository (U6).
Create ModuleRegistry implementation to lookup module coordinates by name (U7).
Implement module info, module list, module register, and module unregister commands to interact with ModuleRegistry (U8).
Perform end-to-end integration testing of the new modules, registry, and CLI commands, and update documentation.
